Commanders vs Giants Betting History

The Washington Commanders and New York Giants have met 118 times since the 1966 season. The Giants lead the series 63-53-2. Against the closing spread the Commanders are 44-68-6 (Giants 68-44-6), and the over is 42-50-2 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Dec 14, 2025, Commanders 29-21.
